verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents that an external AI assistant (e.g., Claude) can create, configure, and manage agents through natural language via the hosted MCP server, and agent-testing docs describe turning real conversations into test cases for regression testing — both are AI-assisted authoring flows. However, this relies on a third-party AI client (Claude) rather than a built-in, platform-native 'describe your agent and we generate it' copilot for prompts/flows within the dashboard itself. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party generative wizard that authors prompts/flows purely from a natural-language description inside the ElevenLabs UI, and evidence of AI-generated (not just conversation-derived) test-case authoring.
